svg.title: KDE bandwidth selection evidence
svg.desc: Three executed charts compare narrow, selected, and wide Gaussian kernel density estimates for fictional service latency. Five-fold cross-validation selects 8 milliseconds, and the selected model scores better than both extremes on 144 untouched final-test rows.
